total_supply_at_construction.meaning: totalSupply value set by the constructor, including the 1 000 000 ghost shares

ghost_share_count.meaning: number of shares included in totalSupply that are never minted to any account (1 000 000)

deposit_overmints_shares.meaning: a deposit mints more shares to the new entrant than the fair pro-rata allocation, diluting incumbents

claims.scope: HypoVault share accounting: constructor sets totalSupply with ghost shares never minted to any account, affecting deposit minting and withdrawal redemption formulas

preconditions.text: HypoVault's constructor sets totalSupply including 1 000 000 shares.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Deposits should mint shares at fair pro-rata allocation and redemptions should release assets per share without dilution from unbacked supply.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Deposits over-mint: new entrants receive more shares than their fair pro-rata allocation, diluting incumbents.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The constructor-set totalSupply is the supply in effect when deposits are processed.
Fair pro-rata allocation is the report's stated benchmark; no exact deposit formula or numeric expected share amount is given.

limitations: The selected impact is formalized qualitatively as a Boolean over-mint outcome because the report supplies no numeric expected-versus-actual share amounts.
The 1 000 000 ghost-share figure is bound only as a lower-bound relation on totalSupply; the report does not state the exact totalSupply value beyond including those shares.
Other impacts (withdrawal under-pay, permanent disadvantage) are not covered by this plan.
